tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo byung tshul gyi lo rgyus bla ma dang bstan srung dges pa'i mchod rdzas ngo mtshar phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan gangs can bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po'i zhabs/ /yab sras khu dbon rim par byon rnams dang / /sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma yab sras gsum/ /'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo yi/ /byung tshul ngo mtshar phreng ba bshad kyi nyon/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo 'di nyid byung tshul gyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ de yang gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos chen mo 'di ni spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi rim/ sde dpon rigs rnams kyi sku rim/ khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i sku'i rim 'gro la dmigs te rje sa skya pa chen po'i sku thog la/ sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / bon nag re ba 'dzu gur gnyis la dmigs te nub phyogs la gnang zhing / khong gnyis lo dang zla ba'i dus ma 'gyang par tshe'i dus byas nas rnam smin gyi phung po gnyis 'dir phyag tu 'byor/ bla chen stag tsha'i snying sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i zhal gdong gi 'brub khung du mdze thod nyis brtsegs thun khung dang bcas pa'i 'og tu dgug gzhug lha dbye sogs rgyas par mdzad nas bcug phung po byings rnams sgo rum gyi them 'og sogs so sor mnan pa dang / re ba 'dzu gur gyi phung po sa skya tshogs kyi nub sgo'i chu 'gram du mnan pa'i las tshogs mthar phyin pa mdzad/ steng du mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhengs te mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing /

bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar te deng sang gi bar du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa 'di yin te/ de'i lo rgyus cung zad zhib par brjod na/ sngon gyi dus bla ma sa skya pa chen po de nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / bla chen de nyid kyi 'phrin las yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i skabs su bdud sprul sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / bon nag re ba 'dzu gur zhes bya ba gnyis kyis bstan 'dzin rnams la shin tu phrag dog pa'i sgo nas/ brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po nyid la yang bar chad mtho 'tshams byed snyam ste/ stag tsha'i slob ma khams kyi ldan ma nas 'ong pa'i ming rdor rgyal zer ba gcig gser gyi bslad nas bla chen bkrong du btang pas/ khams pa des kyang khas blangs nas sa skyar 'ong pa'i tshe/ brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po de nyid sgo rum gzim spyil dkar por bzhugs yod pa la/ khams pa des mjal kha zhus pa na/ de 'phral sku gzhogs su gnang ba'i tshe/ khams pa de na re bdag skye sa khams kyi ldan ma yin zhing / stod kyi phyogs su phyin nas lo du ma song / de nas bla chen khyod kyi snyan pa thos nas dad pa chen pos mjal du 'ong pa lags/ da re zhig khyod kyi zhabs drung du bsdad chog par zhus pa la/ de bzhin du gnang zhing / gzhan yang 'phral du khams pa des gus gus ltar gyi thabs ci 'dra zhig byas nas bkrong ba drag gam snyam du sems pa'i tshe/ bla chen nyid kyis mkhyen bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ nyin cig gi tshe bla chen nyid kyi sku bem gyi nang du rje btsun sku mched rnams dang bcas te yab sras lhan cig tu bzhugs pa na/ de nyid khams pas mthong ba'i tshe 'jig rten phal pa lta bu'i pha bu bsdod lugs 'di 'dra dang bla ma lta ci/ chos pa tsam du yang mi 'dug snyam log lta cher skyes pa'i tshe/

de nyid bla ma chen pos ye shes kyi gzigs pas legs par dgongs te khams pa zhabs drung du 'bod par mdzad nas/ khyod la rnam rtog ngan pa med mchis sam zhes gsungs pas/ khams pa nyid shin tu skrag te rtsab rtsob tu gyur pa na/ bla chen gyi zhal nas gsang sngags pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la log lta byed pa shin tu 'khrul pa yin gsungs pa yin gsungs nas zhabs gnyis bshad kyi skyong bar mdzad pa'i zhabs mthil la kyai rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor bris pa las kyang gsal ba gnyis khams pa la bstan pas/ rdor rgyal nyid shin tu 'gyod par gyur te/ sngar byas rnams bshags pa dang / phyin chad bla chen gyi ched du lus srog gtong bar dam bca' phul/ de nas khams pa des bla chen stag tsha'i drung du phyin te/ sa chen bkrong grub pa lta bu'i tshul smras pas/ bla chen stag tshas de nyid bden par bsam nas mgo 'khor nas rdor rgyal la nye gnas bcol zhing / nged kyi mal sa dang phreng ba 'di la tho reg med cing shin tu gtsang ba rang dus rgyun du bya dgos so zer ba sogs kyi bslab bya mang du byas pa la/ khams pas bsam bzhin du mal sa yang yang du bshig bcos byed pa dang / phreng ba'i mdud pa bkrol te spyod lam du dor ba sogs mi mtshungs pa sna tshogs byas shing / de bzhin du bon nag la'ang byas pas/ khong gnyis kyi ngan sngags kyi tshogs shin tu 'khrugs par gyur te/ de nas de'i skabs der nus mthu'i mnga' bdag bla chen kun dga' snying po de nyid kyis chos skyong mthu rtsal can rnams bran du bkol te drag po mngon spyod kyi las la bskul ba'i sgo nas sngags nag dang bon nag gnyis la dmigs pa'i las sbyor mdzad pa'i tshe/ sngags bon gnyis 'dug sa'i gnas der sngar med pa'i g.yag rgod rog po gnyis rwa brdar la sogs pa drag po'i spyod pa zil dang ldan pa du ma byed pa re re byung zhing /

gzhan yang bya nag khyi nag ce spyang sogs chos skyong gi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang de'i dus byung zhes grags la/ de dang dus mtshungs par dam tshig ldan pa'i khams pa rdor rgyal des/ sngags nag dang bon nag gnyis kyi slob 'khor rnams phyogs gzhan dang gzhan du byer ba'i thabs byas nas/ de nas khong rang gcig pus zhag bcu phrag gsum gyi bar du sngags bon gnyis kyi zhabs tog la che cher brtson pa ltar byas nas/ zhags sum cu tsam lon pa na bla ma dang bstan pa'i phyir du sngags nag dang bon nag gnyis rdzas dang mtshon la sogs pa'i sgo nas srog bral gyi cho ga yang dag pa la sbyar nas/ khong gnyis kyi phung po chos skyong gi sprul pa'i g.yag rgod la bkal te gdan sar 'ong bas/ sa skya pa'i chos skyong gi nus pas mtshan lam gcig la nyin lam drug chod ces grags shing / de nas khams pas bla chen gyi drung du phung po gnyis phul bas shin tu dges shing bla chen gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyi spyir thig chen sems bskyed dang ma bral zhing / bye brag bla ma dang bstan pa'i phyir du bya ba de bzhin gyis 'dug par nyes pa mi 'byung zhing / sngags bon gnyis kyang skye ba phyi ma ngan song du skye nges pa'i las bsags pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu rnams tshe 'dir tshe thung ba tsam gyi sdug bsngal gyi zad par byas nas/ bla ma dang chos skyong gi nus pas skye ba phyi ma phan chad du yang dag pa'i bde ba'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ba yin pas na/ rang gzhan thams cad tshang ba yin no zhes gsungs shing / khams pa la bya dga' chen po gnang zhing / khyad par tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas nges pa'i gdams pa'i nying khu rnams gnang ste rdor rgyal gyis kyang khams su phyin te bsgom pas grub rtags phyogs med du ston pa'i rnal 'byor pa bar dor phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub thob nges pa zhig byung bar grags so/ /de nas bla chen gyi sngags nag gi snying phyung bar mdzad te hom khung gi nang mdze thod kha sbyor gyi nang du bcug nas bse mgon chen po'i zhal gdong du 'jog par mdzad de/

mngon spyod kyi 'phrin las ci bsam 'grub pa'i bka' bsgo mdzad pa yin la/ dus phyis bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis kyang bse 'bag gi zhal gdong gi hom khung kha phye ba mdzad nas mdze thod kyi nang gi snying la nyams pa'i dgra bo lha gnas gnyis sogs la dmigs pa'i dgug gzhug lha dbye bden brdar sogs mdzad pas/ dam nyams rnams gtan brlag tu thong ba 'di bzhin byung ba yin zhes bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung las yang yang thos shing / da dung yang sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa la gnod pa'i bstan dgra mi srun pa rnams la shin tu myur ba'i las sbyor dgos pa byung tshe bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs te bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar bgyis na rtags mtshan 'byung ba la the tshom mi dgos snyam du kho bo sems so/ /sngags nag gi phung po byin po sgo rum mgon khang gi them 'og tu bla chen nyid kyis mnan pa mdzad pa bzhin/ da lta yang dbu rtse'i bskor lam nas phung po'i snod kyi rkyal pa kun gyi mthong bar yod do/ /bon nag re ba 'dzu gur gyi phung po ni chos khri thang mo che'i nub sgo'i 'khris kyi chu 'gram na mchod rten gyi 'og tu mnan pa mdzad pa yin pas/ 'di la ched gtad kyi bskor ba mi bya zhing / gal te byed kyang mgon po'i rtsa sngags dang bzlog bsad kyi sngags rnams bzla zhing bskor ba g.yon bskor du bya ba yin par gsungs so/ /'dir skabs kyi sa chen gyi dngos slob khams pa rdor rgyal dang / bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal gnyis ming zur 'dra yang ngo bo mi gcig ste/ phag gru'i mtshan la rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya zhing / 'dis ming rdo rje rgyal po zhes zer ro/ /'di lta bu'i sngags nag dang bon nag gi lo rgyus 'di rnams ni/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun yin zhes sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis bka' phebs ji ltar gnang ba bzhin 'jam dbyangs sku mched gnyis ka'i gsung las thos pa dang /

lhag par 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos sa skya'i gnas bshad gsung rtsom gnang 'phro thor bur bzhugs pa rnams las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin la/ de ltar rje sa chen gyi sku ring la sngags nag bla chen stag tsha dang / ben nag re ba 'dzu gur gnyis la dmigs nas drag po'i las sbyor mdzad pa'i tshe rtags mtshan myur du byung ba'i dus thog der slad nas kyang sku rim du dmigs nas lo re bzhin gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos chen mo'i gtor mdos nub phyogs la gnang ba'i rgyun de nyid/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i sku ring la 'bri khung pas zhabs 'dren bsgrub pa la brten mdos gtor shar phyogs la gnang ba yin te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ hor gyi rgyal po go dan la hor gyi rgyal rabs kha cig las/ jing gir gyi sras ga gan dang / tho lo no yon gnyis kyis che ba ga gan la gu yug dang / go dan te sras gnyis/ chung ba tho lo la sras mong gol dang / se chen rgyal po/ hu la hu te gsum byas nas go dan dang hu la hu gnyis yab sku mched kyi sras sku mched dang / hu la hu yang se chen gyi gcung du bshad cing / rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi hor gyi rgyal rabs tshig bcad ma yang de dang bstun nas mdzad par snang la/ gzhan yang rgyal rabs rnams su mi 'dra ba sna tshogs zhig byung yang / 'dir ni stag tshang deb gter gyi dpe dag pa 'ga' zhig 'phan nag gi lo rgyus kyi yi ge rnying ma rnams gzhir bzhag nas bris pa'o/ gcen po hu la hu bya ba dang / gcung go pe la zhes pa se chen rgyal po dang mched gsum yod pa'i/ go dan gyi blon thabs mdzad/ khrims ra thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ se chen rgyal sar bkod/ phu bo hu la hu la dbang rigs cher med pa nas go dan gshegs dang bstun ngo log brtsams se chen 'don rgyu yin pa la/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas thabs rten 'brel dang /

byin rlabs srung 'khor sogs mdzad pas/ se chen la rgol ma thub/ mthar 'u thug nas hu la hu na re/ da khyod rang rgyal po gyis nga rang sa cha gzhan du spyad pas chog dmag dum cig blangs/ nga rang gzhan du 'gro zer ba la/ se chen gyis dmag khri phrag bcu bdun byin pa rnams 'khrid nas stod du phyin/ sa cha hor yul ding chen zhes bya bar gzhi bcas mang du 'phel ba deng sang stod hor du grags pa 'di yin zhing / bla ma 'phags pa'i byin rlabs kyis se chen la rgyal sa len ma thub pas/ 'phags pa rin po che la 'khon du bzung / 'bri khung pa dang / phag gru ba'i sbyin bdag byas/ deng sang 'phan nag tu grags pa'i stod hor gyi sgyer thags dang bkral thags gtso che ba'i gos la gser bsgril thags kyi snang ba rab 'byams bkra ba'i gos 'phan mdun ngos gos chen kha bsgrigs dang / rgyab yug bsgrigs 'ba' zhig byas pa'i nyis thog ma khyad 'phags 'di nyid kyi gtsos pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ 'bri khung pa ci gsungs dang len byed kyi yod pa'i skabs/ 'bri khung pas bsdod ma shes/ sa skya pa la zhabs 'dren bsgrub snyam/ dgon pa dbon pos stod hor 'bod par kho rang ngos kyis phyin/ hu la hus bu ga du rin chen bya ba'i rgyal po'i gtsos pa'i stod hor gyi dmag 'bum phrag mang po 'khrid nas yong pas/ gdan sa nas kyang thos/ dpon chen kun dga' bzang po dang / dpon chen ag glen gnyis kyis dbus gtsang gi dmag khri tsho bcu tsam 'khrid nas gdong bsur phyin pas dpal mo dpal thang du thug bod dmag khri tsho bcu tsam gyis stod hor gyi dmag dpung 'bum phrag mang po thal bar brlog hor stong phrag mang po bsad pa'i rtags la rna 'jog g.yas pa rkyang pa bcad nas dres khal mang po bkal/ ga du rin chen dang / dgon pa dbon po gnyis brtson du bzung 'khrid yong pas/ lam du rna ba rnams rul byung pa thang grangs sar lto sar nyi ma la bton nas bsang pa'i lhas la deng sang rna ba lhas su grags/

de dus 'phags pa rin po che pho brang na bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas/ gong ma yon mchod la gnas tshul 'bul ba'i gser yig pa mngags dus/ gong ma'i lung gi ga du rin chen la nyes pa med pas kho rang thong / dgon pa dbon po khrims chod ces phebs pa nas/ dgon pa dbon po sa skya'i mdun la ma 'khrid/ dpon po ri'i rgyab bskor te/ mgo la su khug bkon/ mgo mdun rgyab bsgyur nas rta la bskyon te tshong 'dus khrims khang du 'khrid ske bcad/ snying rgyab nas bton/ mgo snying gnyis thug gzungs la bcugs/ dkon khang gi mgon khang thog na yod pa la/ phyis dpon chen ag glen gyis khur nas mgo lha sa rdzong pa la yod pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi mthu rtsal gyis lha sa rdzong pa gtan brlag tu song pa nas da lta mgo gang na yod mi snang / snying thug gzungs la btsugs pa de ka ma nyams pa da lta sna dkar rtse na yod zer ba bzhin kho bos dbus phyogs la gnas mjal dang 'brel phyin skabs dngos su mthong zhing / de nas 'bri khung pa gtan brlag la gtong ba'i bka' bkyon gnang rgyu yin pa la/ 'phags pa'i nye gnas chen mo rin chen ston tshul la sku ngo zhus/ 'phan nag tu grags pa'i 'phan khyad par can de nyid kyi gtsos pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rten 'bri khung pa nag las thar ba byas/ de lta bu'i nag las thar ba'i 'bul ba'i gtso bo yin pas 'phan nag tu grags/ rin chen ston tshul gyi do dam byas phul bas rin chen ston tshul gyis phul bar yang grags/ de skabs dbus kyi thag ring ba'i stag lung pa dang / rgya ma ba sogs dmag la ma sleb pa rnams la hor 'dul dus go chod pa'i mi rta rnams hor 'dra la brdzangs/ mi la zug rgyab chas/ rta la chag chu tsam nyin re la bre bcu re dgos tshul gyi dpon chen gyi phyag rtags sogs mngags sgo gnon btang ba'i thog ma de nas byung bas/ nag chen rnams la dran 'dzin gyi khrims srol bzang po de lta bu btsugs/

'phan 'di nyid las gsum gyur gyi che ba'i gser 'phan du grags pa gser leb thags kyi sangs rgyas kyi sku 'bum phrag mang po dang / chos srung nor lha sogs kyi sku stong phrag mang po bsgrigs pa'i khyad par can de 'phags pa rin chen la snye thang pa grags bzang gis phul zer/ gser 'phan 'di dbu rtse rnying ma nas zhal lho gzigs la skyong / 'di'i zhabs tog tu gdan sa dan nas nyi lde ba dang / shar nub gung gsum sogs nas gser 'phan bkra shis khra ring sogs bya khra ma'i dar shing la thal mar sleb pa'i khyad par can mang po skyong / 'phan nag tu grags pa da lta yang lha khang chen mo'i sgo dmar na bzhugs pa 'di nyid lha khang chen mo nas zhal byang gzigs la skyong / de skabs gdan sa chen po'i rang rang gi bla brang gzim khang gtsug lag khang brang khang sogs so so nas rgya hor gyi dngos spyad mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bton te khang thog nas mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa 'bul ba yin zhes 'phan nag gi lo rgyus sogs yi ge rnying ma rnams las 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che la 'bri khung pas zhabs 'dren de bzhin bsgrub pa la rten gdan sa'i dus mdos chen mo 'di nyid 'bri khung pa la dmigs nas shar phyogs la gnang ba de nyid kyi rgyun ma nyams par yod pa de'i rjes su theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku ring la dbus gong mas sa skya pa la zhabs 'dren che ba byas nas gdan sa chen po 'dir dmag drangs/ lha khang chen mo sogs 'phrogs/ dngul gar lugs las byas pa'i rten gsum thams cad bshig ste mdzo khal lnga bcu drangs pa dang / gzhan yang hor shel khyad par can las grub pa'i mchod cha sogs khyad nor/ rten gsum ngo mtshar ba sa rgyan gnam rgyan la sogs pa thams cad drangs/ lha khang chen mo'i rten gsum la phug ron la sogs pa bya'i gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ka khong tshang ma la shing dra khyad par can yod pa rnams kyang mer bus te rlag par byed pa sogs mtshams med kyi las tshad med bsgrub pa la rten theg chen chos kyi rgyal pos gtso mdzad gdan sa bka' bgros pa rnams kyi dus mdos kyi mdos gtor shar la gnang ba de nyid dbus gong ma la dmigs te gnang ba'i rgyun deng sang gi bar du 'jags pa yin par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gdan sa'i dus mdos chen mo'i phyag len deb bsgrigs su gnang ba las gsal bar gsungs pa ltar yin la/

mdor na dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa sde gdung brgyud dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo gang na yod pa'i sa phyogs la gtor kha ston dgos rgyu gong gi lo rgyus rnams kyi gsal ba bzhin/ don 'di la dgongs nas sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi ma ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i sku ring la yang dam nyams lha sa rdzong pa ngan rgyab byed mi char gtogs dang bcas pa la dmigs nas dus mdos kyi gtor ma nub phyogs la zhal bsgyur gnang ba yin te/ 'di'i lo rgyus rnams 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung las lan gcig ma yin par yang nas yang du ji ltar thos pa bzhin cung zad brjod na/ bstan dgra lha sa rdzong pa'i ngan rgyab byang pa bkra shis stobs rgyas pas byas nas/ 'brog pa brgya dpon smad pa rnams la ngan slob byas/ rta jag par grags pa'i 'brog pa rnams kyi rta pa ru ba dang / kom 'dre ru ba sogs gdan sa chen po la gtogs pa'i sgos ru dang / sa skya'i mi sde'i ba phyugs sogs dang / chos gzhis so so'i phyugs lug sogs 'khyer bcom nyin re bzhin byas shing / de dang dus mtshungs par snga ris rigs 'dzin chen por grags pa dang / gshin rje mkhan po nub dgon par grags pa dang / ko cag 'bro mgon pa dang / gzhan yang sngags pa mthu che ba'i rigs mang po bsags/ lha sa rdzong du bsdus/ bdag po bkras stobs pa rang gi gshin rje tshe bdag gi mchod rten bcas chog thod pa zhal dbye sogs mthu gtad bung che ba rgyun bsrings nas byas te/ mdor na sgo du ma nas nus gang 'thon byas pa na/ sa skya pa la gus zhen yod pa'i sde dpon rigs la sogs pas 'di bzhin byed par 'dug tshul sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la zhu cha phul bas sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ kho rang tsho de bzhin ci byas kyang nga'i ba spu yang g.yo bar mi nus mod/ 'on kyang sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa dang /

khyad par chos skyong la brnyas par 'gyur bar 'dug pas/ lan du rtags 'thon pa rang zhig byed pa yin no zhes zhal bzhes gnang / de nas bzung ste dgong phyogs thugs dam bskang gso rgyun pa'i tshe/ zor gtor khrag byugs pa bzhi re thugs dam drag bskul rnga bshon dang bcas gnang ba dang bstun/ mchod g.yog pa res mi rkang g.yab dar dang bcas pa dang / gzhan ma phyag g.yog res zor gtor chang phud dang bcas 'khyer/ ban gtsang pa bsnyen song rnams re mos kyis shā sa na 'dren cing smad zhing steng du chang phud gtor/ rkang gling gsum re bus/ g.yab dar lan gsum brdabs/ zor gtor dgra phyogs su 'phen par gyis zhes gsungs nas zla ba gcig tsam de bzhin gnang / de nas sgo rum du las sbyor gyi sku 'tshams bdun phrag gsum tsam gnang nas de khar drug cu pa sku rkyang gi sgrub pa gnang rjes ban gtsang pa sogs dang bcas phyag len gnang nas sngar gyi smad zhing steng gi zor gtor bskyal sa der gnang / de nas gdan sa'i dus mdos chen mo 'di nyid nub phyogs la zhal bsgyur bar gnang ste/ de yang brgya dpon brang mo che pa sangs rgyas dpa' bor grags pa dpal mgon zhal la mnga' bsnyes pa nas zhal gyi gtor ma 'phen par bka' gnang zhing / mkhan chen dpal ldan bzang po la pu tra'i gtor ma 'phen par bka' gnang / gzhan bsnyen song rnams la bdud rgyal dang spyi gtor 'phen par bka' phebs cing / zor las pa rnams kyis so so'i bsnyen pa kha gso dang / gtor bsngo skabs dmod bcol sogs rang rang gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs te gang grub gyis shig ces bka' gnang ba bzhin legs par grub pa dang / de nas dus mdos dngos gzhi'i dus chos skyong gi 'chams sku yang 'phags pa'i phyag nas gnang ba rnams dang / bzhi thog pa mkhas btsun chen pos byang pa rta dben bsgral dus chos skyong gi lung bstan bzhin bzhengs pa'i byang 'dul mgon por grags pa sogs ye shes pa bzhugs nges pa'i shin tu gnyan pa'i 'chams mgon lcam dral bdun spyan 'dren par mdzad/

de'i 'khor ru 'dren gyi tshul gyi skyes pa go mtshon can rnams dang / sde'i bud med khyim pa mo rnams lag tu stag dang 'u lu thogs/ ngag tu bh+yoḥdang dmod mo gang shes 'don bzhin pa dang / gzhan yang dge 'dun tshogs pa'i sher snying bdud bzlog sngags pa mang pos drag sngags zlos pa la sogs pa'i zhal bkod dang bcas sngar gtor zor bskyal ba'i sa smad zhing du phebs/ dam nyams gnas pa'i sar zhal phyogs pa'i dpon slob byin pos pho nya bskul ba'i rigs la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i 'das dang ma 'das kyi chos srung thams cad la bden pa brdar zhing dmod bcol rgyas pa'i tshigs rnams dang / rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi man ngag la brten nas mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa'i drang srong dmod pa'i dmod bskul sogs dmod bcol drag tu gnang nas/ thog mar zangs gzhong gcig gi nang na mtho gang tsam gyi gtor ma smug rtsi sogs kyi kha ma bsgyur ba'i zor gtor 'dra ba'i rtser nor bu mig gsum dang zur la me ris khyi gzhug ma byas pa bdun tshar zhig yod pa rnams lag gyogs ltar 'phen pa gnang rjes/ gur gyi gtor chen gnang nas na bza'i g.yab rdo dang 'phrin bcol mang du gnang zhing / de bstun zor las so sos kyang dmod bcol dang gtor ma rgyab grub 'tshams nam mkha' dwangs shing 'jam par yod pa la glo bur du sa skya sde nas 'tshub ma chen po zhig lang nas zor lam phyogs su song te lung grog phan thal rlung chen pos khrig 'gags zhing / de'i gseb tu nam mkhar bya rog kha gdangs nas dgra phyogs su rgyug pa dang / sa la khyi mang po kha gdangs nas rgyug pa ni der 'tshogs kun gyis mthong ngo / skabs der sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos gzigs snang la rlung nag 'tshub ma'i khrod na chos skyong gi pho nya las mkhan rnams drag po'i rngam stabs dang bcas dgra phyogs la rgyug pa mngon sum du gsal bar gzigs nas gtor bzlog grub pa'i bzhugs gral skabs sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/

bka' bsrung rnams dgra bgegs la shin tu rngam par 'dug pas chos srung rnams la gtang rag zab dgos par 'dug go gzhan yang dus mdos zhig gi skabs sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid bzhi thog tshom dmar du bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang la gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring dang bcas pa'i las mkhan lnga kar dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog 'ba' zhig tu byas shing / 'chams tshul rnams kyang dgra bgegs la shin tu khros pa'i nyams kyis sku thams cad 'dar shig ge ba'i rnam pa can 'dug pa shin tu gsal bar gzigs nas/ der skabs 'jam dbyangs sku mched zhabs drung na bzhugs pa la/ las mkhan rnams snang tshul 'di bzhin 'dug pas da phyin 'chams tshul dang cha lugs 'di bzhin gyis shig pa'i bka' gnang phebs pa bzhin deng sang gi bar du phyag len la mdzad pa 'di yin zhes kyang thos so/ zhes bka' phebs gnang bar mdzad la/ de skabs nas bzung srod tho rangs btso rgyug pa sogs rtags mang du byung zhing / de dang dus mtshungs par gong du bshad pa ltar/ lha sa rdzong du mthu mkhan 'dus pa rnams la tshogs 'khor zab par bsham pa'i gral gtam la/ snga ris rigs 'dzin pas/ bdag po bkra shis stobs rgyas drung dang / lha sa nas khyed zhang dbon sku stobs dang ldan pa'i skabs 'dir/ chu mgo ya gir chos log mkhan 'di tsho med par mdzad dgos rgyur 'dug ces gleng ba na/ dpal rtse ba dang / mtsho sgo ba sogs dpon rigs thams cad yid ma rang par mgrin gcig tu zhal ngo gdung brgyud kyi sar 'thad mi 'thad sna tshogs la rten zhabs 'dren phran bu yang zhu dgos yong gi 'dug mod/ grub mtha'i cha rgya bod hor sogs thams cad du chos lugs dpal ldan sa skya pa las lhag pa gzhan med cing / rnam par dag pa mkhas grub thams cad mthun nang grub cing 'gran zla dang bral ba yin/ de 'dra'i gtam chos spong gi las bsog pa 'dug rna ba dgag dgos pa'i gtam yin zer ba sogs thams cad rgyud 'khrugs par gyur/

gral la 'ur lang dang rdog pa bsdebs pa sogs rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byung / zhes phyis der 'dus pa thams cad gleng bar grags shing / de nas lha sa rdzong nas so sor gyes/ snga ris rigs 'dzin pa byang du theg mchog gling du brdzangs pa yin no zhes thos so/ /de nas myur bar snga ris rigs 'dzin pa tshe'i dus byas pa na/ byang pa bkras stobs pas slob dpon pad+ma'i sku thog tshad gcig bzhengs/ de'i khog tu rigs 'dzin pa'i phung po bcug kha rin spungs la bstan/ ro'i kha gdangs pa'i nang du kho rang tsho la gnag pa'i byang pa'i dpon rigs/ rin spungs pa'i zhal ngo dpon blon sogs kyi ming rus sogs dang / rgyal mkhar rtse pa'i zhal ngo rnams kyi ming rus dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan byang 'jug par byas te/ rigs 'dzin chen po khong rang gi kha chems yin zer nas mthu byas pa'i lugs su byas/ bkras stobs pa rang gi tshe bdag mchod rten bcas chog sogs sna tshogs byas so/ /de skabs su sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid chos rgyal bsod nams lhun 'grub pa sku mched rnams kyi rgyal mkhar rtser spyan drangs/ phebs lam gyi bar du bsam 'grub rtse/ tshong 'dus nor bu khyung rtse rnams su spyan drangs/ so sor 'dod chos gegs sel sogs legs par stsal zhing bka' drin tshad med pa bskyangs nas/ rgyal rtser phebs bsu ser phreng zab ma dang bcas spyan drangs/ sde srid zhal ngo rnams dang dges par mjal/ zla ba gcig lhag tsam bzhugs skabs zhal ngo rnams kyi thog drangs dad ldan skya ser mang po la dges rdor gyi rgyu dbang / phur pa'i stod las kyi dbang / gu ru drag dmar gyi dbang / tshe dpag med lha dgu ma dang / grub rgyal ma brgya tshar/ gzhan yang zhal ngo rnams la chos skyong gi rjes gnang lha brgyad thun mong ma yin pa/ lcam dral lha gsum/ gur dpa' gcig rnams dang / dmag zor ma/ tsa turmu kha bsnyen dus/

dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud/ bran bdud/ dmar po bskor gsum rnams kyi rjes gnang / bdag po ma chen sar/ lam zab/ bir srung / lam dbang / rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs srung 'khor brag rdzong ma sogs zab chos dang zhal gdams mang du gnang / de skabs su bstan pa dang sbyin bdag rnams la dgongs te/ rtse rgyal mgon khang du gur zhal 'khor bcas kyi brtag gtor dang 'dzin gtor yang 'dzugs pa gnang ba yin no zhes kyang thos la/ gzhan yang sde srid zhal ngo rnams kyi sku rim du phur bzlog zhig gnang ba mdzad cing / de skabs su rgyal rtse li ma lha khang gi g.yab khrar sde srid zhal ngo rnams la pha rol gyi byad kha rbod stong gi rtags che bar byung bas/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la de bzhin gyi gnas tshul phul ba ni/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las kyang / byad kha'i rtags 'dra shin tu yang 'dug pas/ de la dmigs nas gur zhal la brten pa'i gsang gtor zhig byed pa yin no zhes thugs brtse bas bka' drin bskyangs te zhag gsum tsam song ba na/ sde srid ma chen nyid sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gzhogs na bzhugs yod skabs su/ mgron gnyer bas 'brug pa'i sgar pa yin zer ba cig phyag dbang cig thugs rje che dgos zhu bar 'dug pa na/ sde srid ma chen gyis sgar pa de skye sa rong lhun rab pa gshin rje'i las mtha' ngan sngags rang byed mkhan chos rgyal dpal bzang zer ba zhig yod pa de yin 'dug pa phyag 'bul la sku gzhogs su mi gnang ba dgos zhus pas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ kho rang dad nas phyag 'bul du yong ba min/ gshin rje sogs la brten pa'i mgo 'jog 'khor lo zer ba'i gzhan gyi tshe dang bsod nams mthu stobs sogs nyams par byed pa ngan sngags kyi 'khor lo zhig yong bas/ kho'i mgo gtsug na 'khor lo de btags yod pa de'i khar nga'i rab rkang pa/ de min lag pa 'jog dgos rgyu yin pas/

nga la de 'dra'i rigs kyis glags kha na da tshod nga'i ming gi lhag ma yang sa steng na lus pa med/ khyed rang zhal ngo tsho gtor ma'i mdun du bzhugs la gtor ma la nas 'bru sogs 'thor du ma 'jug gzhan khyad med thong gsungs/ khong dpon g.yog gsum 'dug pas mjal dar bkra shis kha thags zhig dang bcas 'dug pa la/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos phyag gnyis kar gyi phyag dbang gnang nas dpral ba mthil zhal la thug gi bar gnon pa gnang song bas/ sgar pa de shin tu 'jigs shing dpa' 'khongs/ gdong rngul 'dzag cing 'dar zhing dngangs pas phyir thon song bas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyi bka' phebs gnang ba bzhin kho'i spyi gtsug na tim pa'i thum byas pa'i srung ba zhig btags 'dug go zhes kyang thos la/ de dgong sde srid ma nyid sku gzhogs na bzhugs yod pa na/ thugs dam gtor ma'i rtse mo chad byung bas/ de nas cung zad song ba na tsheg sgra dang me stag khrom khrom byas byung 'tshams gtor ma nas me 'od chad de g.yab khra'i phyir song ba na/ phyag g.yog sogs phyi na yod pa rnams kyi bsam pa la gzim khang gi nang la me shor bar 'dug snyam nas g.yab khra'i nang du stab stob tu sleb par gyur cing / de nas me de nam mkhar 'thor nas phyogs thams cad la song ba der yod kun gyis mthong ba yin no zhes grags la/ de nas thugs dam gsang gtor de nag rtsi shar nas gnang ste/ skabs der sngags 'chang nyid kyi gsung las/ nged rang mchod yon gyi dgra bgegs rnams la rtags mtshan myur du yong ba 'dug gtang rag tu sa skya'i mgon khang rnams su thugs gso/ spyan gzigs/ gtor gso/ bskang gso sogs gang drag mdzod gsungs shing / de nas rgyal mkhar rtser zhal ngo rnams kyi tshogs 'khor zab par zhus shing / so so nas 'bul sgrub bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang skabs su sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung las/ da lam rten 'brel shin tu legs shing dam tshig shin tu gtsang bar 'dug pas rnal 'byor pa'i lam goms pa'i rtags cig ston pa yin no gsungs nas sing sbal chen mo re shong ba'i dngul rkyan mda' tshad ma zhig chang gis bkang nas dal bus lhugs shig zhes bka' gnang nas/

zhal gyen du cung zhig gdangs tshul gnang bar/ gzim g.yog pas dngul rkyan bteg nas zhal du zhus pa na/ chu sbug du chu 'gro ba ltar bde bar khyu ru ru 'gro ba'i ngos dngul rkyan gang po zhal du rdzogs par gsol te/ sku la ma bde ba'i nyams sogs gnod pa cung zad kyang med pa chab bsang pa tsam yang mi dgos pa sogs/ rgya gar gyi grub chen rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi yul khams bco brgyad kyi chang dus cig la zad par gsol yang myos pa med par la sogs pa'i rnam thar dang mthun pa'i grub pa'i rtags mtshan de lta bu mngon sum du ston par mdzad cing / de nas sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyi thong lcags su phebs/ mgon khang na bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i las sbyor gnang ba'i drag po'i 'brub khung ling ga sngags can mdze thod kha sbyor/ drag po'i thun sogs bcas tshang ba yod pa dang / drag po'i sbyin sreg gi thab khung sogs dang / bdag chen rin po che'i gsol phod re phod/ dbu zhwa zhwa nag bzhugs gdan sogs thams cad da lta'i bar du yod pa'i drag po'i mgon khang khyad par can der/ spyi dgos kyi bstan dgra rnams la dmigs nas bdun phrag gsum du sku mtshams bcad rgya gnang nas/ las sbyor/ las mtha' btul ba sogs mthar phyin par gnang rjes su bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i gsol phod re phod/ dbu theb sogs sku la bzhes pa'i chas gzhug gnang / rgyal rtse nas bdag po ma'i drung sogs dang / ban gtsang pa'i phyag g.yog dang bcas drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog zhig gnang zhing / mgon khang de nyid du rdza sder gnyis su mgon po khro bcu'i gtor ma mar gyi nor bu mig gsum me ris kyi rgyan cha tsam yod pa cha gnyis byin rlabs mdzad de 'jog pa gnang nas/ 'di gnyis rgyal rtse pa la dgos skabs gal che ba gnyis yong bas de dus re re 'phangs pas don 'grub par yong gsungs bas lung bstan dang bcas 'jog pa gnang zhing /

de dag dang dus mtshungs par gdan sa chen por gzhir bzhugs skya ser phyogs mtha'i mi dmangs thams cad kyi mthong bar/ hor zla gsum pa'i nyer dgu'i nub sa rub pa na 'ga' zhig gi mthong snang la gdan sa chen po'i bzhi thog nas byung zer ba dang / la las pu tra khang nas byung zer ba'i gang ltar kun gyi mthong bar gdan sa dan khrod nas btso rdza ma tsam zhig byung nas dal bus lung grog thad du cung zhig bsdad/ de rjes kha'u'i rong nas lang pa lta bu'i btso snga ma las nyis 'gyur gyi che ba cig byung nas snga ma de'i rjes tsam du sleb pa na/ de nas sde'i dkyil nas byung ba 'dra ba'i btso shin tu che ba zhig byung nas dbus ri'i thad tsam du me ltag mang po chad nas phyogs bcur 'thor/ de nas btso gsum po de reg la ma 'brel tsam du dbus ri brgal nas song ba thams cad kyi mthong zhing / dbus ri brgal nas cha gnyis su gyes nas gcig 'brog pa brgya dpon gyi sa cha shrī ri brag gi rtsa bar babs pas brag gas pa'i srub nas khrag rgyugs pas bong chu'i gzhogs cig khrag mdog tu gyur pa song byung zer ba sa yul de phyogs nas byung ba'i skya ser thams cad mgrin gcig tu gleng ba byung zhing / slar gdan sa rang nas phyin pa'i mi sna rnams kyis kyang dngos su mthong ngo zhes thos la/ cha gcig ngam ring theg mchog gling gi spen bad la phog pa na/ de'i tshe byang pa bkras stobs pas theg mchog gling du sngags pa mang du bsdus pa rnams dang khyad par bo dong gi sngags pa rnams ngag mthun par/ rngod la'i rtser btso gsum byung nas tshur sleb pa na gcig tu 'gril te theg mchog gling rang gi spen bad la phog pas spen mas me blangs te tshig pa na/ sngags pa rnams kyi gtor ma dang thun 'dra rgyag mdo phran gyi po ti 'dra ba brdabs pa sogs gang drag ci drag byed par 'dug ces kho rang sngags pa rnams kyis dngos su sgrog par gyur cing /

phyis sor byang pa'i dpon rigs rnams kyang mgrin gcig tu gleng bar byed do zhes thos so/ /de lta bu'i lo rgyus de rnams ni bdag gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi gsung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dang / dus mtshungs bden par smra ba gzhan dag gi ngag las kyang thos pa bzhin bkod pa yin la/ de ltar sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos dam nyams lha sa rdzong pa char gtogs dang bcas pa la dmigs nas gdan sa'i dus mdos chen mo 'di nyid nub phyogs la gnang ba nas bzung / yun ring ma lon par bstan dgra dmigs yul thams cad gtan rlag tu gyur cing / de nas slar yang mdos gtor sngar gyi rgyun bzhin shar phyogs la gnang ba'i phyag len de nyid da lta'i bar du lo re bzhin rgyun ma chad par sgrub pa la brten/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs rje dang bka' srung khyad par can rnams kyi mthu rtsal la brten spyi dang bye brag gi dgra bo thams cad 'bad pa med par rang zhir gyur te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung brgyud dang bcas pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar te deng sang gi bar du dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa'i legs tshogs phun sum tshogs pa 'di bzhin byung ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo 'di nyid sgrub pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' bzhin spyi dgos kyi bstan dgra gdug pa can rnams drag po mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba'i las mdzad pa la rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa'i tshul gyis gang bcol ba'i las rnams 'bad med du bsgrubs pa ni nges pa'i don la gnas pa yin te/ de'i tshul rnams sngon byon pa'i rtsod pa dang bral ba'i skyes bu mchog dag gi thugs dam gzigs snang la shar ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus 'di ltar thos te/

de yang sngon gyi dus su dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ge nyid gdan sa chen po'i dus mdos dang stabs cig par gdan sar phebs skabs/ nyer dgu'i nyin gdan sa pa dpon slob rnams kyis tshogs chen mor rol mo bcams te/ shā sa na'i sngags dbyangs dang / las mkhan gyi bstod bskul gyi dbyangs rnams mdzad skabs/ kun mkhyen chen po sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i drung na bzhugs yod pa'i zhugs dgongs la dbyangs dang rol mo rang la dgos par cher med dam/ de bas nged rang ye shes pa dngos dang khyad par med pa'i bse mgon 'di nyid kyi drung du bzlas pa byas pa 'thad dgongs nas de bzhin mdzad cing bzhugs pas/ dar tsam zhig la ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral las mkhan dang bcas pa rnams mngon sum du gzigs snang la shar te/ khong chos skyong rnams ni tshogs chen mo'i dbyangs rol dang bstun/ phan tshun gcig gi gcig la khyod 'gro ran byung / nga 'gro ran byung zer ba sogs mi la mis lab pa ltar byas nas thog mar las mkhan rnams dang / mthar gur gyi mgon po rang yang byon song bas/ kun mkhyen chen po'i thugs la sa skya pa'i phyag len rnam par dag pa'i dbyangs rol 'di rnams/ gzhan gyi ting nge 'dzin lo brgya bsgom pa dang / sngags lo brgya bzlas pa bas nus pa che ba 'dug dgongs nas thugs lhag par dad de/ de dus zhabs drung na yod pa'i skal ldan 'ga' la/ a la la sa skya pa'i dbyangs rol gyi phyag len 'di rnams ngo mtshar chen po red/ nged la mthong snang ya mtshan can 'di ltar byung gsungs shing / gzhan yang nyams ldan gyi gsung gis ra lpags 'di tsho yang nyed dgos rgyur 'dug bong skad 'di tsho yang 'don dgos rgyur 'dug ces kyang gsungs par grags shing / gzhan yang 'di lta bu'i lo rgyus yid ches can mang du yod kyang 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros la/

rgyas par shes par 'dod na kho bo'i ngag las btsal bar bya zhing / spyir yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa gdon mi za ba'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa rnams las rim par brgyud pa'i dbyangs rol gyi phyag len ngo mtshar can 'di rnams ni legs par sbyangs shing lhongs su khyur pa dag gis gsung rab zab mo'i don gyi gnad rig par byas nas/ bskyed dbyangs/ mchod dbyangs/ bstod dbyangs sogs so so'i ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas dang 'dod kyi dad pa chen pos nyams su blangs na so so skye bo rnams mgu zhing spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa dang / 'phags pa rnams dges par 'gyur la/ de la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po thob pas na phan yon dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan 'tshang rgya ba la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs dgos la/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs la rag las par gsungs pa'i phyir te/ mdo bsdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs pa/ /de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi byed/ /ces gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro'i dbang po ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams gang zag dbang po yang rab kyi dbyangs kyi nga ro kho nas kyang 'grub par gsungs te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po la bod kyi rgyal pos bka' gnang ba bzhin/ lo chen de nyid kyis rgya gar du byon chos rnams mkhyen nas bod la 'byon khar slob dpon shar+dhī drung du chos skyong khyad par can cig gnang dgos zhus pas/ khyod rang rdo rje gdan gyi byang sgo'i mgon khang du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshom la/ hūm̐ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can/ /zhes sogs bstod pa sho lo ka gsum po bskyar gyin bstod la ltas rtogs shig de nas ltas khyad par can byung ba dang man ngag byin gyi gsungs/

lo tsā bas de ltar mdzad pas ltas cig kyang ma byung / slar bla ma la zhus pas/ bstod pa de snyan pa'i ngag gi glur long la bstod cig gsungs/ de ltar byas pas zhag bdun gyi tho rang gzim mal du mi nag po gcig byung nas/ khyod lho nub kyi dur khrod du song la 'jigs pa'i nga ro'i skad la dpe gyis la bstod cig zer ba byung bas rdo rje gdan gyi lho nub kyi dur khrod du byon nas tshogs 'khor bsham ste gsol ba btab pas/ ji zhig tsa na mi ro chen po gcig la stag gnyis babs nas ngar gyis bza' yi 'dug pas de 'jigs pa'i nga ror go nas/ slar rdo rje gdan gyi mgon khang du log nas stag ro bza' ba'i ngar skad la dpe byas te/ srin gzugs ma la stag mo'i ngur dbyangs mdzad nas bstod pa mdzad pas/ zhag gsum gyi srod la 'jig rten gyi khams gang ba'i nag po chen po'i sku mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs can gri thod thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ gaṇ+ḍe phyag gi dbus na bsnams pa zhig zhal gzigs pas/ re zhig thugs dran med du brgyal/ brgyal ba de sangs pa dang gzigs tsa na de'i sku las kyai rdo rje dang / 'khor lo bde mchog la sogs pa'i yi dam bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ bdag gi lus la thim snyam byed pa dang / dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma thugs la 'khrungs te zhag gsum gyi nyi ma snga dro tshun ting nge 'dzin gcig gi ngang la gnas par gyur/ de las sad pa na'ang mahā kā la nyid de khar snang ste/ nag po chen po'i zhal nas gdam ngag rjes su nod cig bod du bstan pa srung ba la bdag khyod dang gdong nas 'gro bar bya'o zhes gsung byon/ de'i tshe nag po chen po'i 'gying la gzigs shing bram ze chen pos mdzad pa'i bstod pa sngon tshe bde gshegs ma la mgon po'i 'gying dbyangs mdzad/ dbyangs 'di la che chung gnyis yod pa'i che ba ro lang ma zhes grags pa yo ga'i dbyangs dang mthun pa cig yod pa de rgyun chad nas mi bzhugs/

ding sang gi 'di chung ba yin zhes gsungs/ dus de nas bzung ste chos skyong 'bral med du gzigs kyi yod gsungs so/ de nas bla ma la zhus pas/ da dung lha mo la sngar bzhin gyis gsungs pas/ de ltar byas pas rmi lam du bud med nag mo gcig byung nas/ mahā bo dhi'i gan+dho la'i rtsar song la rlung phog pa'i shu sgra la dpe gyis/ rdo rje gdan gyi skor khang gi shing pa sha ru'i yal kha 'gying pa la dpe gyis la res 'jog tu glu long la bos cig ces lung bstan/ bstod pa mi pham mar grags pa de lta bu'i dbyangs ma bu gnyis mdzad pas nyin zhag gcig na lha mo yang zhal gzigs/ de nas bla mas bka' bsgos rjes gnang man ngag rnams gnang ste bod du byon/ chos skyong gi rten dang man ngag rnams bod du byon pa tsam gyi lha 'dre nus pa can rnams dang / bon po nus pa can rnams nus pa chung du song zer/ lan cig bon po dang 'gran te/ lo chen gyis pu tra la las bcol bas/ pu tra bon po'i steng du 'gror ma btub cing log la khad byung ba la/ sngags rnams zhang gzhung gi skad du bsgyur te las sbyor byas pas de ma thag 'grub par byung bas/ de phyin chad bod rbad bsad gsum zhang gzhung gi skad du yod pa yin gsungs/ dus phyis slob dpon pad+mas bsam yas su gter du sbas pa 'thon pa la'ang de bzhin byung bas/ phyi rab la de ltar byas pas phan par mkhyen pa yin zhes gsungs bas ding sang pu tra'i bod rbad bsad gsum la saṃ skri ta'i skad kyi klag lugs byed pa dang / skad rigs du ma 'dres pa sogs ni sa skya'i gong ma rnams kyi dgongs pa min par gsal lo/ /dpal ldan lha mo la rgya bod kyi so 'tshams su lo tsā ba chen po thugs skyo ba gcig la chu bo chen po zhig gi rba rlabs kyi nyer la gzigs nas/ til mar gyis bskus la dbyangs mdzad pa deng sang gi 'di yin no/ /lha mo 'di nyid zhi drag phyed ma la sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i bstod pa yod do/

/lo chen bod du byon dus chu bo chen po la brgal ba na klu rnams kyi bstod pa'i dpe brkus nas chu la 'khyer/ der rjes tho gling gser gyi lha khang du lha mo yun ring ma byon par/ lo chen gyi lha mo la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ lha mo'i bstod pa de'i sho lo ka gcig 'khyer byon nas lo chen la gnang / gzhan rnams klus bdag la bstod kyin 'dug pas 'khyer ma yong / nga khyed can du da bar yong ma khom pa klu rnams kyi bstod pa de'i gdangs snyan pas yengs pa yin gsungs/ de nas lo tsā bas gling bu ltar sgra snyan cing gsung rtser nas lha mo la bstod pa sho lo ka gcig po des bskyar gyin bos pas myur du 'byon pa cig byung gsungs bar grags shing / yang dus phyis bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan nyid nor bu khyung rtser phebs pa'i skabs zhig gi tshe/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje rkyang 'dur ba dpon slob dang gzim khang steng 'og tu mdzad nas bzhugs/ rje dpon slob rnams kyi tshom 'og tu chos skyong rnams las la bskul ba'i rol mo drag rdung mdzad pa na/ steng du chos rje rkyang 'dur ba'i dgongs pa la/ mtshan nyid pa rgan po'i skyon gyis slad pa'i/ rnga rdung 'di la rang 'byung chen po med dam snyam pa byung / de nas cung zad song ba'i dus chos rje rkyang 'dur ba'i gzigs snang la sprul pa'i mi nag khyi nag bya nag sogs pho nya mang pos/ 'byung po chen po snam sbyar ta hun gser ma thang theb gyon pa dang bcas pa'i ske nas zhags pas bzung / lag pa bsdams pa cig dkar khung gi mthong kha nas tshom chen 'og ma'i 'brub khung nang du thogs med du 'khrid song ba gzigs/ zhag gcig song rjes phyir shor song / dgong thun gyi thugs dam gyi tshe slar yang gong bzhin 'khrid nas mthu dang stobs med par dam la thogs par gzigs te mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ de phyin chad rnga rdung la yid gang yod ches pa gcig byung bar gda' zhes bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi rnam thar las 'byung ba yin no/

/de ltar gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo byung tshul gyi lo rgyus bla ma dang bstan srung dges pa'i mchod rdzas ngo mtshar phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung rigs dri ma med par sku 'khrungs shing / mthu stobs dang thugs rje tshad med pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa nges pa'i don du 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig na bza' dang / gos dkar lcang lo'i mdzes pa'i sku'i snang brnyan tha dad du bstan nas sems can gyi don du bsam bzhin sprul pa'i skur byon pa la som nyi dang bral ba'i rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi spyi gzugs dam par gyur pa rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje'i 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don 'grub la sogs te yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po grub na snyam pa'i rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar gyi cha tsam 'dzin pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rigs dang chos kyi bu la sogs te rang dang skal ba mnyam pa'i slob ma'i tshogs rnams la phan par bsam zhing / rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs rnams kyang dges par gyur cig snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs te/ me pho stag gi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i dmar cha mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo bsgrub pa'i cho ga'i mtshams rnams su mgyogs par bris te/

bzhi thog bla brang gi yangs rtse mkha' spyod bde ba can smon gnas yid 'ong tshal du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho rab mnyes nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob bu sdug ltar bskyangs te/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ ka l+ya na war+dhan+hū// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 a myes zhabs/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i dus mdos chen mo byung tshul gyi lo rgyus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
